text:
alyssa: heads-up — the Go quickstart in /docs/quickstart-go.md has a couple of copy/paste gotchas that tripped our internal sample app tests this morning.

devlin: ugh, what happened?

alyssa: the env var in the README is REDWOOD_API_KEY but the Go client code reads REDWOOD_TOKEN. tests failed with `missing credentials` and it took a bit to realize it was just a name mismatch. :facepalm.

samir: also noticed the import path is the old repo name in the sample: `github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/v1` — we moved to `github.com/redwood/redwood-go` last quarter. CI linter flagged it when running `go mod tidy`.

jules: can you paste the snippet? I can open a quick PR.

alyssa: sure — current README block is:```
import (
  "context"
  "os"

  "github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/v1"
)

func main() {
  apiKey := os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")
  client := sdk.NewClient(apiKey)
  ctx := context.Background()
  _, _ = client.Generate(ctx, "hello")
}
```

alyssa: to make it work it needs two changes: env var -> `REDWOOD_TOKEN` and import -> `github.com/redwood/redwood-go`. also the `Generate` call signature changed (now returns `(resp, err)` and requires opts).

samir: suggested corrected snippet:```
import (
  "context"
  "os"

  "github.com/redwood/redwood-go"
)

func main() {
  token := os.Getenv("REDWOOD_TOKEN")
  client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithToken(token))
  ctx := context.Background()
  resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateOptions{Prompt: "hello"})
  if err != nil {
    panic(err)
  }
  fmt.Println(resp.Text)
}
```

Jules: I'll open a tiny PR to update the file, add a note about env var names changing in v0.9 -> v1.0, and add a CI check that runs the README snippets with `go test` so snippet drift is caught earlier.

devlin: thanks — can we also add a short migration note in the changelog and a deprecation warning in the old SDK package (so users see compile-time error)?

alyssa: yeah, adding both. one more small thing: the README uses `context.Background()` inline in some examples where we should demonstrate deriving a ctx with cancel for production examples. I'll tweak one example to show `ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)` with a comment.

docs-bot: @jules opened PR #412 updating quickstart-go.md, fixing import path and env var, and adding a migration note. Tests: snippet-checker passed.

samir: verified locally, thanks — leaving a small nit about formatting but not blocking.

jules: merged PR. i'll follow up with the CI snippet-runner ticket to add Go snippet execution to the quickstart test matrix. :rocket:
